lines: Bakul Hiralal Shah may sell up to 12,600 shares, bringing up to ₹1.70 crore in proceeds, if all offered shares are sold.
Up to ₹1.26 crore gain, before offer expenses and taxes, if all offered shares are sold.
Proceeds are in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago); the trigger is shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, shares not cash, which is recent (66 days ago).
Family link: shares surname Shah and middle name Hiralal with Atul Hiralal Shah. Retained value of ₹3.97 crore is an estimate.
